beats.say: The recent proof of the Riemann Hypothesis came with a startling statistic attached: the proof is 17 million lines of Lean.
Mathlib maintains a collection of over a thousand famous proofs, but only 259 have Lean versions charted — and this one dwarfs them all.
For scale, the human-led formalization of the famous Fermat's Last Theorem runs about 60,000 lines, and it is still in progress.
